RCA V4 Scoring Formula Reference

Cycle score = S1_score*0.20 + S2_score*0.30 + S3_score*0.50.

Full-cycle min-max normalisation is used before stage slicing.

MAE and RMSE are combined with 50/50 weight.

Exponential score uses k=2.2.

Exhaust is safety pass/fail only and does not affect cycle score.

Score Model — weights, caps, bands, cycle formula: 

SCORING FORMULA (complete): 

Normalisation: P_norm(t) = [P(t)−min(P_full)] / [max(P_full)−min(P_full)] ← full cycle

MAE per stage: MAE_sX = (1/n) × Σ |P_norm(t) − B_norm(t)| for t in stage window

RMSE per stage: RMSE_sX = √[ (1/n) × Σ (P_norm(t) − B_norm(t))² ]

Combined error: combined_sX = 0.5 × MAE_sX + 0.5 × RMSE_sX

Stage score: stage_score_X = 100 × e^(−2.2 × combined_sX) k = 2.2

Cycle score: cycle_score = S1_score×0.20 + S2_score×0.30 + S3_score×0.50

Exhaust: NOT in score. Pass/fail only → Sheet 8.

STAGE WEIGHTS — rationale: 

S1 = 20%: Air purging. Important but partial compensation possible if S2/S3 strong.

S2 = 30%: Fruitlet loosening. Directly affects stripping efficiency and oil loss.

S3 = 50%: Holding / sterilization. Most critical. Determines FFA and oil extraction yield.

Observed data: S2 AVG=65.8, S3 AVG=92.9 → Stage 2 is current weakest link. RCA priority = S2.

RCA DEDUCTION CAPS (per stage): 

Boiler cap: −25 pts max per stage evaluation

BPV cap: −20 pts max per stage evaluation

Competition cap: −20 pts max per stage evaluation

Network cap: −20 pts max per stage evaluation

Local cap: −15 pts max per stage evaluation

Cycle chronic cap: −30 pts max at cycle-level chronic rules

Why caps?: Without caps, multiple rules from one group firing = unbounded negative. Cap ensures score stays 0–100 and attribution remains meaningful.

SCORE BANDS — oil loss context: 

≥ 90 — Excellent: combined_error < 0.05. Curve closely follows benchmark. Oil loss minimal.

75–89 — Good: combined_error 0.05–0.13. Minor deviation. Acceptable. Monitor trend.

60–74 — Fair ⚠: combined_error 0.13–0.23. Noticeable deviation. Investigate. Moderate oil loss risk.

< 60 — Poor ✕: combined_error > 0.23. Significant deviation. RCA required. High oil loss risk.

< 50 — Critical ✕✕: combined_error > 0.30. Severe. Immediate inspection. Very high FFA and oil loss risk.

Primary root cause: Group with highest total deduction after caps

Secondary root cause: Group with 2nd highest deduction if > 5 pts
